workflow.name: Feature Architecture
workflow.trigger: design feature, plan implementation, technical design, how should we build, design for
workflow.description: Mid-level design for new features within existing systems.

step.goal: Design feature within existing system constraints. Define interfaces, data changes, and integration points. Document migration path if schema changes required.
Validate design fits existing patterns and conventions. Identify integration risks and edge cases.
Incorporate valid critique. Finalize feature design.
